run_http2_test_server: run the HTTP/2 test server with argparse --base_port flag to start servers on incrementing ports
start_test_servers: start one HTTP/2 test server per test case on incrementing port numbers beginning with a base port
create_H2Factory: create an H2Factory instance that builds HTTP/2 protocol handlers for a specific test case
listen_endpoint: listen on a Twisted TCP4ServerEndpoint with an H2Factory and handle listen errors by stopping the reactor
parse_arguments: parse command line arguments to get the base port for starting HTTP/2 test servers
